description:
Cast a copy of Improvised Act from exile by paying one mana, unpreparing Pompous Battlemage.
Displacer Kitten and Storm-Kiln Artist both trigger.
Resolve the Displacer Kitten ability, flickering Biblioplex Tomekeeper.
Biblioplex Tomekeeper triggers when it enters, preparing Pompous Battlemage.
Resolve the remaining trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana.
Resolve the spell from step 1.
Repeat.
